sanitized_message: The tea gift box arrived crushed and two sachets are damaged. What photo evidence do you need?
required_evidence: clear photo or video of the damage
next_steps: Verify the order and delivery date.
Ask an authorized support lead to confirm refund or replacement eligibility.
response_draft: Thank you for contacting support. Under POL-RET-001, please provide order number, clear photo or video of the damage. A support reviewer will verify the information before confirming any resolution.

trace.purpose: Validate ticket identity, channel and message.
Remove email, payment-card and password text before policy matching.
Match the sanitized ticket to explicit policy keywords.
Attach the approved policy, evidence requirements and service deadline.
Route critical or explicitly escalated cases to an authorized human owner.

limitations: Classification uses explicit English keyword rules, not semantic understanding.
The response draft is policy-grounded but still requires an authorized human before sending.
The public workflow uses synthetic policies and does not connect to a ticketing platform.
